Mission & Vision
The college has the noble vision of occupying a prestigious position in the field of higher education of women to transform itself into the centre of excellence. It always remains an earnest endeavour on the part of the college to Empower the girls' student economically, politically and socially. Help them to become responsible and worthy citizens. From Principal's Desk
Dr. Nara Kanta Adhikary,Principal
Dakshin Kamrup Girls' College is the lone institution for girls based on rural and semi urban background in entire south Bank of river Brahmaputra from West Guwahati to Goalpara. During the last few years the institution has witnessed significant changes in academic as well as in infrastructure fields.
